details.claim: Tardigrades can withstand extreme temperatures, vacuum, and radiation.

In 2007, samples of 30 tardigrades and 30 eggs, all dehydrated, were taken on the FOTON-M3 mission and exposed to vacuum, to both vacuum and UVA & B light, or to both vacuum and the full range of solar ultraviolet, for 10 days.
Tardigrades can survive impacts up to about 900 metres per second (3,000 ft/s), and momentary shock pressures up to about 1.14 gigapascals (165,000 psi).
